messages:
maya patel: kicking off model-route v2 deploy to canary in the quiet window. plan: feature flag `route.v2_enabled` ramp with auto-sla. starting at 0.5%.

deploy-bot: Queued deploy db-8811. Canary instances: 3. Healthchecks enabled.

sam wilson: proposed ramp: 0.5% -> 3% after 8m -> 15% after 25m -> 40% after 50m -> 80% after 90m -> 100% after stable 3h. hard rollback criteria: error_rate >0.6% OR p95_latency increase >120ms. soft-hold on anomaly detection.

jordan lee: note: cold KV cache will cause initial p95 blip for ~4m. recommend ignoring bursts <3m in the first 10m after scale.

alex choi: adding autosla hook now. config preview: ```yaml
flag: route.v2_enabled
start: 0.5
steps: [3,15,40,80,100]
step_durations: [8m,17m,25m,40m,rest]
auto_sla:
  enabled: true
  metrics:
    - name: error_rate
      threshold_pct: 0.6
    - name: p95_latency
      threshold_ms: 120
  action: rollback
rollback_target: model-v1-stable
```

maya patel: can we set a manual holdpoint at 40% for human signoff? put oncall in the loop. also add tracing debug sampling to 100% for 10m post-40%.

sam wilson: can do. i'll watch the canary dashboards and post check-ins.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 0.5%. Healthchecks: passing.

jordan lee: pushing warmup note to release notes: "expect transient latency bump due to KV cache warmup (~3-5m)."

sam wilson: moved to 3% at +9m. p95 +18ms, errors 0.09% - green. advancing per plan.

alex choi: merged small deploy-config PR that pins fallback target and TTL=1800s. snippet: `POST /flags/pin {"flag":"route.v2_enabled","version":"model-v1-stable","ttl":1800}`

maya patel: 15% at +27m. small spike at +2m mark then normalized. remembering to ignore <3m blips.

sam wilson: reached 40% holdpoint. metrics steady. holding for human approval. oncall has been paged. :eyes:

jordan lee: oncall acked and checking traces. nothing concerning. ready for 80% after signoff.

alex choi: deploy-bot auto-sla rule armed. if triggered, it will rollback to model-v1-stable and pin for 30m.

maya patel: approving continue to 80%. keep manual pause at 80% if any oscillation.

sam wilson: 80% -> small regional latency skew in eu-west, but within thresholds. holding 10m and monitoring.

jordan lee: started pin script in case of rollback: `curl -X POST https://internal/flags/pin -d '{"flag":"route.v2_enabled","version":"model-v1-stable","ttl":1800}'` ready.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% scheduled after remaining soak.

sam wilson: final status: 100% live, no auto-rollback. release notes updated: "model-route v2 rolled to prod via gradual FF ramp; auto-sla rollback guards added; warmup guidance included."

maya patel: excellent. filing a short retro item to revisit thresholds and warmup ignore windows. thanks all. :tada:
